suggest.drupal/ui_icons: Provide Icons feature in Display builder
suggest.drupal/ui_skins: Provide CSS tokens features in Display builder

scripts.composer-root: d=.; i=0; while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do if [ -f "$d/composer.json" ] && cat "$d/composer.json" | grep -q '"type"' && cat "$d/composer.json" | grep -q '"project"'; then readlink -f "$d"; break; fi; d="../$d"; i=$((i+1)); done
scripts.phpcs: mkdir -p test-results && composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpcs -- --standard=$(pwd)/.phpcs.xml --report-width=auto --colors -s --report-junit=$(pwd)/test-results/phpcs.xml --report-full --report-summary $(pwd)
scripts.php-cs-fixer: composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec php-cs-fixer -- fix -vv --config=$(pwd)/.php-cs-fixer.php --allow-risky=yes $(pwd)
scripts.phpstan: mkdir -p test-results && COMPOSER_MEMORY_LIMIT=-1 composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpstan -- --memory-limit=1G --configuration=$(pwd)/phpstan.neon --error-format=junit analyze $(pwd) > test-results/phpstan.xml || true && COMPOSER_MEMORY_LIMIT=-1 composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpstan -- --memory-limit=1G --configuration=$(pwd)/phpstan.neon analyze $(pwd)
scripts.phpmd: mkdir -p test-results && COMPOSER_MEMORY_LIMIT=-1 composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpmd $(pwd) -- --exclude 'tests/*,**/tests/*,**/Hook/*,*/IslandWithFormTrait.php,*/IslandConfigurationFormTrait.php' text $(pwd)/.phpmd.xml
